name: Riko-tan wa Oji-chama ga Suki♪
original_name: リコたんはおじちゃまが好き♪
source:
Rico-tan loves uncles and does a lot of pleasant things. What will she do today?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-february-2005-steel.html]vndbreview[/url]]
